title: GPU dependency sanitizer: prune stale CUTLASS artifacts and harmonize Triton bindings
creator: Priya Shah
description: On a handful of customers and CI runs we still observe sporadic kernel symbol resolution failures and duplicated CUTLASS artifact overloads during node startup. This ticket aims to sanitize the GPU dependency surface: remove stale CUTLASS/aux artifacts from runtime bundles, add a lightweight linter to catch duplicate symbols at build time, and harmonize Triton binding layers so the runtime chooses a single consistent ABI path per node. The goal is to reduce startup jitter, shrink image sizes, and lower the volume of transient fallbacks observed in telemetry.
acceptance_criteria:
1) No duplicate CUTLASS .so files in runtime bundle for standard build matrix (cuda11/12/13)
2) Kernel-probe logs show a deterministic binding path chosen and recorded in node metadata
3) Startup jitter (time to first successful model load) improves by >=15% in internal benchmark across mixed GPU fleet
4) No regression in unit/egress tests; CI flaky kernel-load failures reduced to <=1% of previous rate
5) Linter runs as part of build and fails on duplicate symbol/package overlaps
technical_notes: Plan: run an inventory pass across current kernel artifacts, classify files into canonical runtime assets, legacy compatibility shims, and removable cruft. Implement a build-time linter (Python script + bazel rule) that checks: SONAME/SONAME collisions, duplicate basenames, mismatched symbol versions. Add a runtime 'binding-decider' hook that consults node hardware/probe results and writes chosen ABI path to /meta/kernel_binding.json for observability. For Triton, unify binding by introducing an opt-in environment variable REDWOOD_TRT_BINDING=stable which maps to the new reconciled linkage; fallback preserved but logged. We'll stage the change behind a feature flag and roll to canary pools first.
rollout_plan: 1) CI-only: run linter in PRs for two weeks. 2) Canary: enable binding-decider + reconciled Triton binding on 2 canary GPU nodes per region for 3 days. 3) Uplift: if metrics pass, expand to 10% of Dedicated fleet; monitor for 48h. 4) Full: rollout to remaining nodes with 1-hour health checks and automatic rollback on error thresholds. Rollout gated by QA signoff and runtime-1.20 cut.
test_plan:
- Unit: linter tests with synthetic .so sets.
- Integration: deploy to staging fleet with instrumented kernel-probe to validate metadata and fallback counts.
- Performance: run internal model-launch benchmark (seq len 1024) comparing baseline vs sanitized bundle.
- Chaos: simulate missing shim files to ensure graceful fallback and clear telemetry.
